input.overview: Orbitor 1 turns ball control into the central rule. Lock a ball in the left-side lock, then complete the seven top O-R-B-I-T-O-R drop targets to release it and begin two-ball Multiball. Complete the left three-target bank and the lower-right three-target bank to advance Bonus X as high as 15x. The two spinning rubber discs and the molded lunar surface redirect shots unpredictably, so controlled survival and complete bank sets matter more than repeating a single lane.
input.simpleOverview: Lock a ball on the left, then complete the seven top O-R-B-I-T-O-R drop targets to start two-ball Multiball. Complete the left and lower-right three-target banks to build Bonus X up to 15x. Expect both spinning discs and the curved playfield to change every return.
input.summary: Secure the left lock when offered, finish O-R-B-I-T-O-R before chasing scattered points, and take complete three-target banks for multiplier progress whenever the ball settles near a flipper.

quickInfo.summary: Complete O-R-B-I-T-O-R with a ball locked.

steps.text: Shoot the left-side lock to hold one ball.
Knock down all seven top O-R-B-I-T-O-R targets while the ball remains locked.
The completed letter bank releases the lock and starts two-ball Multiball.
Complete the left and lower-right three-target banks to advance Bonus X toward 15x.

alternatives.title: Multiplier-first route
alternatives.when: Use this when the lock is not safely available but one three-target bank is nearly complete.

steps.text: Finish the nearby three-target bank for the next Bonus X step.
Return to the lock and O-R-B-I-T-O-R route after the ball settles near a flipper.
Lock one ball on the left side.
Complete all seven O-R-B-I-T-O-R targets to release it.

machineSetup: Check lock release, O-R-B-I-T-O-R reset behavior, Bonus X steps and carryover, ball-time replay threshold, and any outlane or center-drain adjustments.
Test the left lock, all seven top drops, both three-target banks, both spinning rubber discs, playfield leveling, flippers, and the single center drain switch.

techniques.name: Nudging
techniques.instruction: Use small, early nudges while the ball circles a gravity well; late corrections on the molded surface are much less predictable.

cautions.issue: The molded playfield and rotating discs make repeated shot outcomes highly variable.
cautions.response: Plan around complete objectives and safe control windows instead of assuming a return path from the previous shot.
